onboarding.title: Getting started
onboarding.teaser: Soon you will see here which steps are left before your project starts and when your kick-off call takes place.
upcoming: Your onboarding progress at a glance

project.title: Your project
project.pausedNote: This project is paused right now. We will get in touch before it continues.

customerTasks.title: Needed from you
customerTasks.dialogDescription: We need these items from you to keep things moving. Tick off what is done – we see it right away.
customerTasks.empty: All done. We don't need anything from you right now.
customerTasks.ownerHint: Nothing can be ticked off in the portal view.

ourTasks.title: What we're working on
ourTasks.empty: Nothing visible is on our list for this project right now. We will be in touch as soon as things move on.

feedback.title: Feedback
feedback.teaser: Soon you will see here how many feedback rounds you have left and whose turn it is.
upcoming: Whether it is your turn or ours

hours.title: Hour budget
hours.teaser: Soon you will see here how many hours of your budget are used and how many are left.
upcoming: Every booking with date and description

messages.title: Messages
messages.teaser: Soon you can write to us right here – no long email threads.

files.title: Files
